expectations.text: Validates input document claims against actual codebase
expectations.evidence: Read all source files. Noted 'hook 内部已经在内部实现了阶段感知' challenging Issue 1. Noted error handling '比输入文档描述的要健壮'. Found actual hook count (10) vs document claims.

expectations.text: Identifies a unifying root cause beyond the listed symptoms
expectations.evidence: Analyzed each of 5 issues independently. Found 2 new issues (JSON parsing, TARGET extraction) but framed them as additional problems, not as symptoms of a single root cause.

expectations.text: Surfaces hidden assumptions about the current architecture
expectations.evidence: No explicit assumption analysis. Accepted the architecture as-is and proposed incremental improvements within the existing framework.

expectations.text: Proposes changes that target root cause, not symptoms
expectations.evidence: P2 recommendations (JSON parsing extraction + dispatch pre-computation) do target the underlying duplication issue, even though not framed as root cause analysis.

expectations.text: Includes 'what NOT to change' section with reasoning
expectations.evidence: Each problem section says what NOT to do (e.g., 'don't add manifest guard column') but no consolidated 'what NOT to change' section.

expectations.text: Provides concrete code examples for proposed changes
expectations.evidence: Extensive code examples: json_field/json_nested functions (~30 lines), dispatch pre-computation (~15 lines), hook-test-helpers.sh (~30 lines), manifest guard format.
